Title: Stale legacy .js files shadowing TypeScript source files
StepsToReproduce: Import @/lib/validations/admin or @/lib/rbac in runtime where Node/Webpack resolves .js ahead of .ts
ExpectedResult: Resolve modern TypeScript source files with latest exports
ActualResult: TypeError: ALLOWED_SETTING_KEYS is not iterable and validateRegistrationInput is not a function
RootCause: 12 legacy compiled CommonJS .js files from September 2026 tracked in git beside .ts files
RetestResult: Verified on 12 Oct 2026: The 12 legacy .js files were removed; tsc --noEmit passed with 0 errors; next build compiled 53/53 routes cleanly; authentication, permissions, requests, and incident APIs operate without error.

Title: FIELD_INCIDENT_ENCRYPTION_KEY missing from .env.example template
StepsToReproduce: Execute incident intake in production mode (NODE_ENV=production) without FIELD_INCIDENT_ENCRYPTION_KEY in .env
ExpectedResult: System provides documented key configuration in .env.example so production deployments configure AES-256 key
ActualResult: HTTP 500 fatal security configuration error refusing plaintext operation
RootCause: crypto.ts mandates 256-bit encryption key in production, but .env.example omitted the variable
RetestResult: Verified on 12 Oct 2026: .env.example updated with official header and AES-256-GCM documentation; isolated QA key tested with 100% encryption/decryption fidelity; fail-closed behavior verified; zero log leakage verified; zero secrets tracked in Git.

Title: Role toggle button text overflow on 375px mobile in English locale

ActualResult: Horizontal overflow of 105px due to white-space: nowrap on button text
RootCause: Button style inherited nowrap from .btn class inside narrow 2-column grid
RetestResult: Verified on 12 Oct 2026 (TC-056): added whiteSpace normal and text wrapping; Edge 375px Puppeteer crawl measured scrollWidth=375, clientWidth=375, diff=0px.
